author: Mark Atwood
text:
Confirmed: the 'unhandled backend error variant' pattern is workspace-wide. Audit covers 8 extension-server crates with the same code shape (counts approximate):

  - mail-server: 7+ sites across email.rs, mailbox.rs, identity.rs, vacation.rs, sieve.rs, submission.rs, mdn.rs
  - chat-server: 9 files (ban, contact, presence, emoji, space, message, invite, position, chat)
  - calendars-server: 4 files (calendar, event_notification, participant_identity, event)
  - contacts-server: 2 files (card, addressbook)
  - filenode-server: 1 file (filenode.rs, 5 sites — the bead's diagnosis)
  - sharing-server: 2 files (notification, principal)
  - metadata-server: 1 file (helpers)
  - tasks-server: (no matches in current pass — may already be different shape; needs verify)

Total sites: ~30-50 across 8 crates.

Two layered fixes:

Option (a) — minimum, propagation-only: change the catch-all arm body from
  json!({ "type": "serverFail", "description": "unhandled backend error variant" })
to
  json!({ "type": "serverFail", "description": format!("unhandled BackendSetError variant: {e:?}") })
across all ~30 sites. Mail-server canonical first, then propagate to 7 siblings. Pure local mechanical change in each crate; no API surface change. Risk: Debug format of a #[non_exhaustive] variant is not API-stable, but for an internal diagnostic this is acceptable.

Option (b) — better, foundation-first: add a stable label method to BackendSetError in jmap-server (foundation crate) that returns a &'static str discriminator (e.g. 'serverFail', 'invalidProperties', 'unhandledVariant'). Then propagate the catch-all-arm shape across all 8 extension-server crates to use this label. Two-phase change: foundation crate + 8 propagation passes.

Recommendation: (b) folded into the existing workspace propagation epic JMAP-xbeb (which already consolidates similar workspace-canonical doc/API gaps: .39 re-exports, .40 handler docstrings, .44 trait doc auth-contract). Add this as a fourth concern. (b) gives a stable label the handler can use without depending on Debug format; (a) is fine for the interim if a fast win is desired, but creates Debug-format coupling.

Decision needed: (i) commit to JMAP-xbeb as the umbrella; or (ii) file a separate workspace propagation epic specifically for the BackendSetError unhandled-variant pattern.

NOT done autonomously because: (a) is a 30-site cross-crate mechanical sweep with no propagation epic filed yet (workspace AGENTS.md canonical-template rule says workspace-wide sweeps need explicit human signoff before committing); (b) adds public API surface to jmap-server foundation crate.
